uncertainty_scope: Paired number-group bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 2026091714, with all six states resampled jointly; skeleton-family clustering is a sensitivity analysis. Targets and samples remain nested. Intervals exclude training-seed, parent-seed and data-assignment uncertainty. The two recipes are not two seeds. Exploratory intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted; a zero-containing interval is not evidence of equivalence, and an empirical [0,0] interval is not proof of population zero.
